data.title: Le Ciel – Port de La Mer
data.about:
Introducing Le Ciel in Port de La Mer. Choose from 1 – 4 bedroom apartments with views of the sea and Dubai skyline. 

Port de La Mer is a fantastic freehold island community in Dubai with amazing amenities and an island lifestyle with direct beach access. These are freehold apartments that can be owned by foreigners from across the world.

location_tile.title: Le Ciel is nestle in Port de La Mer
location_tile.description:
Famous island living located minutes from the major landmarks of the city. Le Ciel is a waterfront community with access to the beach, La Mer.

  • 5 min – La Mer
  • 10 mins – City Walk
  • 10 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 15 mins – Dubai International Airport
  • 45 mins – Al Maktoum International Airport
